criteria.criterion: In crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, earlier_attempt accepts a job closed as failed as well as rejected; other states (open, accepted, stale, etc.) still bail with a message naming the state and that only rejected or failed jobs can be tried again.
criteria.evidence: reading.rs:752-760 matches JobState::Closed(Rejected | Failed); anything else bails with "job {id} is {state}; only a rejected or failed job can be tried again".

criteria.criterion: carry includes the job's recorded outcome reason (e.g. 'admission refused the change: ...') as a finding, redacted, when the job has no verification record. A failed job with no verification record no longer triggers the 'no verification record' bail.
criteria.evidence: reading.rs:876-888 pushes "outcome: {reason}" when the job failed or has no verification, before redactor.redact_all. The bail at 764 now fires only when both the verification and outcome records are missing.

criteria.criterion: The 'Earlier attempt' section in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs says the job failed or was rejected according to its actual state, rather than always 'was rejected'; the new request still takes precedence.
criteria.evidence: briefs.rs:375-386 picks "failed" or "was rejected" from attempt.failed. The new request is still quoted first under "# Request (verbatim)", and the test reader_briefs_say_a_failed_earlier_attempt_failed asserts the new request stays as typed.

criteria.evidence: Both files now say failed jobs (such as one refused at admission) can be tried again and that their recorded reason is carried into the "Earlier attempt" section; both match the code.

findings.summary: The shared carry() helper now also adds outcome reasons to the "Referenced jobs" section, which is untested and not documented
findings.evidence: referenced_jobs calls carry(). Any referenced job that failed or has no verification (including stale or abandoned ones) now gets an 'outcome: …' entry. The README's "Referenced jobs" paragraph still says only the request and the final verification's findings are shown, and no test covers this path.

summary: The change does what was asked. `athena ask "try again on <job>"` now accepts jobs closed as failed as well as rejected. For a failed job, it carries the recorded outcome reason (for example "admission refused the change: …"), redacted, into the reader's "Earlier attempt" section, and that section now says "which failed" or "which was rejected" depending on the job's state. Every other state is still refused, and the message now says only a rejected or failed job can be tried again. New unit tests (reading.rs, briefs.rs) and a new lifecycle test cover the change. The lifecycle test fails at admission for real, then retries; it would fail on the base code, which refused non-rejected jobs. I ran `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets`, `cargo test -p athena-cli --test lifecycle` and `cargo test`; all ran clean, including the existing retry tests. CHANGELOG and README are updated and match the code. The diff does not touch run.rs or manage.rs, though the reading listed them as deliverables; the fix did not need them. There is one minor side effect: the shared `carry` helper now also adds outcome reasons to the "Referenced jobs" section, which is untested and not documented.
